newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CARACAS STOCKS EDGE UP ON LOCAL INVESTOR DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: CARACAS STOCKS EDGE UP ON LOCAL INVESTOR DEMAND.

text.p: Local investor interest added 52 points to the Caracas stock market index Thursday for a close at 9,506 points, traders said.
The 0.55 percent advance was attributed to 33 companies which saw their stocks rise, versus five which fell and nine that stayed unchanged.

Volume was unusually high and dominated by cross trades because the Mercantil group, which includes the country's second largest bank, created a new holding company Mercantil Servicios Financieros MVZa.CR MVZb.CR.

Mercantil's broking arm Merinvest carried out cross trades worth 235 billion bolivars ($475 million) to transfer Banco Mercantil and Consorcio Inversionista Mercantil (CIMA) to Mercantil Servicios Financieros.
Total exchange volume was 244 billion bolivars ($493 million) on 1,562 trades.
